cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Yes, Under My Physics
cards.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Absolutely, I'll help move your boxes downstairs. Help means saving effort; I'll call the lift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's broken. Carry that box yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Certainly. Yourself means without involving you. I'll hire a mover.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He'll carry them if you hold the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. Holding means preventing movement. I'll wedge the door open and supervise from this chair.

mechanism: A agrees to its former moving pupil requests while redefining help, yourself and holding so the pupil must accept A seated supervision.
confusable: Not refusing to help: A supplies a substitute action under every explicitly accepted term.
comparison: Staying in photographic shade versus avoiding manual labor by purchasing and arranging help.
seedUse: D167 boxes/lift/mover/wedge/chair; S05 efficient lifting lesson and supervisory praise.
